scope: Showdown settlement UI and desktop simulated SIK gestures

features.card_privacy: During play only human hole cards are exposed to the human client. Completed showdown reveals only dealt-in, non-folded participants. Uncontested settlement reveals no hole cards. Next hand clears reveals and winner labels.
features.winner_semantics: Union of actual main-pot and side-pot award recipients; supports split pots and winners with zero or negative whole-hand net. Refund-only recipients are not winners.
features.display: Gold WINNER / SPLIT WINNER labels, English hand categories for showdown participants, main-pot winner and decisive ranks or kickers, compact side-pot winner summary.
features.payload_validation: Rejects premature or folded-player reveals, invalid or duplicate cards, invalid settlement structures and inconsistent awards; legacy payloads without settlement retain a private fallback.

native_scenarios.coverage: complete hand, settlement UI and next hand
visible desktop simulated SIK raycast/pinch and camera movement
complete check/call hand through showdown and legitimate table-finished state

native_gesture.interaction: Desktop simulated SIK raycast and pinch
native_gesture.recording_boundary: Successful gesture invocation does not prove a recording was saved or a final video was reviewed.

initial_failure.cause: The demo script incorrectly required a next hand after the human stack reached zero; this was not a game-rule failure.
initial_failure.fix: Respect can_start=false as a legitimate terminal state; show Table finished and do not force a redeal.

full_demo.next_hand_validation: Covered independently by ar-holdem-offline-hand on a funded table.

video.gameplay: Native Lens Studio SPECS desktop preview; Lucas v16; real simulated SIK hand pinch and native LEAF button controls; full hand to river showdown; ATLAS queens beat YOU sevens; table ends with human stack zero.
video.editing: 1x gameplay; idle-time cuts; aspect ratio preserved; English captions and eight-second closing title; no synthetic gameplay
video.validation: Full ffmpeg decode passed; hand and settlement frames visually inspected.

visual_checks.content: winner, English hand category and caption

api_validation_boundary: Local mock endpoint coverage does not establish authentication or availability of a real external provider.
evidence_handling: source_artifact values are basenames of local temporary diagnostics inspected for this report, not repository files. Only sanitized results are embedded; personal absolute paths, full logs and credentials are excluded. Review links are repository-relative.

recorded_showdown.human_actions: check/call only; both remaining players all-in on turn, followed by automatic river runout
